options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Level Access
options.doc:
Completing a level a certain way will give a random item.
Choose what type of level access item gets added to the pool.

Shuffle Levels - You will receive levels as items which will allow you to select that level at any time.
Shuffle Paths - You will receive paths as items which will allow you to take that path to other levels.
options.doc_html:
Completing a level a certain way will give a random item. Choose what type of level access item gets added to the pool.

Shuffle Levels - You will receive levels as items which will allow you to select that level at any time. Shuffle Paths - You will receive paths as items which will allow you to take that path to other levels.
options.doc_fr:
Remplir un niveau d'une certaine façon donnera un élément aléatoire.
Choisissez quel type d'élément d'accès de niveau est ajouté à la piscine.

Niveaux de choc - Vous recevrez des niveaux en tant qu'éléments qui vous permettront de sélectionner ce niveau à tout moment.
Souffler les chemins - Vous recevrez des chemins comme des éléments qui vous permettront de prendre ce chemin à d'autres niveaux.
options.doc_html_fr:

options.name: Shuffle Starting Level
options.doc:
If Level Access is 'Shuffle Levels', shuffle which level you start with.
You normally start with Corneria.
options.doc_html: If Level Access is 'Shuffle Levels', shuffle which level you start with. You normally start with Corneria.

options.name: Shuffle Medals
options.doc:
Shuffle the medals awarded by reaching a certain number of Hits in each level.
Earning a medal will give a random item, and you will visually see the medal on the map to indicate that you've completed the check.

Note: Medals are very challenging in vanilla.
Unless you know what you're doing, it is recommended to lower the score needed for each level using their options.
options.doc_html:
Shuffle the medals awarded by reaching a certain number of Hits in each level. Earning a medal will give a random item, and you will visually see the medal on the map to indicate that you've completed the check.

Note: Medals are very challenging in vanilla. Unless you know what you're doing, it is recommended to lower the score needed for each level using their options.

options.name: Shuffle Checkpoints
options.doc:
Shuffle checkpoints rings for the levels that have them.
You will not be able to use the checkpoint ring in a level until you receive the item for it.
options.doc_html: Shuffle checkpoints rings for the levels that have them. You will not be able to use the checkpoint ring in a level until you receive the item for it.
